purpose: The bar across the top of the app with the product name, main navigation, search and account actions.

props.name: nav
props.type: Array<{ label: string; href: string; current?: boolean }>
props.description: Primary navigation links; below breakpoint-md they move into a menu

props.name: actions
props.description: IconButtons and an Avatar at the end

props.name: layout
props.description: auto follows the viewport (compact below breakpoint-md); wide or compact forces one. Defaults to auto

whenToUse: Once at the top of every page of an app
whenNotToUse: Inside a page section — use a heading
For more than six top-level sections — use SideNav
antiPatterns: Hiding search behind an icon when it is the main task

anatomy: A bordered bar: optional menu button (compact), logo and title, primary navigation, spacer, search, actions
states: Nav links `color-text-secondary`, current `color-text-link` with a `color-interactive-default` indicator; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`

a11yNotes: A banner landmark; the navigation is a landmark named Primary
The current page has aria-current page
Below breakpoint-md the navigation is a menu behind a Navigation IconButton
